mapper.select: SELECT /* LGVPAYP0002.retrieveExecutionList */ pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , ccmc.common_code_name AS pay_type_name , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pcp.payroll_calc_period_value, 'YYYYMM'), 'MM/YYYY') AS pay_month_name , pcs.payroll_calculation_set_name ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id) AS employee_count ,( SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(creation_date), 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') FROM tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id) AS execution_start_date ,( SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(creation_date), 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') FROM tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id) AS execution_end_date , pce.confirm_flag , NVL(pce.retroactive_flag, 'N') AS retroactive_flag FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n pcp ,tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c ccmc ,tb_pay_calc_set_n pcs WHERE pcp.payroll_calc_period_value = TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{payrollCalcPeriodValue}, '/', ''), 'MMYYYY'), 'YYYYMM') AND pcp.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pce.basis_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(pcp.start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(pcp.end_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD') AND ccmc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_PAY_RUN_TYPE' AND ccmc.common_code = pce.payroll_type_code AND ccmc.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND pcs.payroll_calculation_set_id = pce.payroll_calculation_set_id AND pce.payroll_type_code = #{payrollTypeCode} ORDER BY pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id DESC

SELECT /* LGVPAYP0002.retrievePayrollCalculationExecIdData */ pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id , ccmc.common_code_name AS pay_type_name , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(pcp.payroll_calc_period_value, 'YYYYMM'), 'MM/YYYY') AS pay_month_name , pcs.payroll_calculation_set_name ,( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id) AS employee_count ,( SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(creation_date), 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') FROM tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id) AS execution_start_date ,( SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(creation_date), 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') FROM tb_pay_calc_emp_exec_n WHERE payroll_calculation_exec_id = pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id) AS execution_end_date , pce.confirm_flag , NVL(pce.retroactive_flag, 'N') AS retroactive_flag FROM tb_pay_calc_period_basis_n pcp ,tb_pay_calc_exec_n pce ,lgcom_common_code_multi_lang_c ccmc ,tb_pay_calc_set_n pcs WHERE pce.payroll_calculation_exec_id = #{payrollCalculationExecId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND pcp.subsidiary_code = #{LGVHR_PROJECT_SESSION.subsidiaryCode} AND pce.basis_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(pcp.start_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TO_DATE(pcp.end_yyyymmdd, 'YYYYMMDD') AND ccmc.code_type_code = 'LGVHR_PAY_RUN_TYPE' AND ccmc.common_code = pce.payroll_type_code AND ccmc.language_code = #{USER_SESSION.languageCode} AND pcs.payroll_calculation_set_id = pce.payroll_calculation_set_id
